claim_boundary: Task-independent visual encoder controllability and frozen-policy transfer only; no full chart, score, or training.

encoder.no_motion_rule: If displacement across the full past window is not positive, emit blank input.
encoder.cue_gate: If ttc_hat > 500ms, emit blank input while preserving velocity history. At ttc_hat <= 500ms, emit q.
encoder.position_source: Current and past normalized rendered screen positions only; no target timestamp, future schedule, note ID, judgment, or score.

geometry_controls.error_bound_basis: One-pixel screen quantization over a 50-ms velocity window at the slowest tested constant speed; rounded up before outcomes.

abrupt_speed_controls.continuity_rule: Position at switch equals the distance accumulated at the pre-switch speed; no positional jump.

frozen_policy_gate.pass: Each seed/speed pair emits exactly one correct-lane DOWN within ±73.5ms of receptor crossing and one UP 10ms later; exact repeated trace; matched untrained silent; weights unchanged.
